_note: What `the checks pass` means here. Read by .claude/hooks/_projectchecks.py, which the auto-commit gates on. Any key may be a command string, or false to disable that check as a stated decision. An absent key means detect it.
_why_disabled: No TypeScript and no configured linter in this repo -- it is hooks, skills and their suites. Stating that here is deliberate: an absent key would be silently indistinguishable from a linter nobody wired up.
